outcome: Presence of bacteriophage DNA in human umbilical cord blood
cohort: Participants included 10 pairs of maternal and cord blood samples (4 with preeclampsia) and 62 paired maternal and cord blood samples (43 from preterm or chorioamnionitis-affected deliveries).
finding: This study demonstrated the presence of bacteriophage DNA in human cord blood at birth, providing evidence that the human fetus is exposed to bacteriophage DNA in utero.
